title: Online ordering / kiosk sync verification
summary: After structural changes, force sync and verify price+availability windows; confirms channel visibility matches intent.

steps.title: Force the sync
steps.instructions: Commandpoint/integration panel > "Sync with Clover"; price and availability land within ~10 minutes; everything else follows the 4-hour window.

steps.title: Verify on the customer-facing device
steps.instructions: Open the kiosk/online menu as a guest: item names, prices, option popups and group availability must match the POS exactly. Log any drift with timestamps for the support case.
